# Prebuilt frameworks

Third-party frameworks Textual ships as prebuilt binaries, unmodified. Everything else is built from source in this repository.

| Framework | Version | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Libraries/Sparkle.framework` | 2.6.4 (2039.1) | [Sparkle](https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle) | `Documentation/LICENSE-Sparkle.txt` |

SHA-256 of `Sparkle.framework/Versions/B/Sparkle`: `8f68e5d824b32526f68260ba3b0402ab5eb51a196e0aabfdfae90efac688675a`

This copy came from Codeux's Static-Libraries repository. It will be replaced by the current official Sparkle release; when updating, use an official release archive and record its version and checksum here.

Sparkle is used only by the direct-download build. The App Store build neither links nor embeds it.
